contents.scope: Independent local CPU reconstruction; no archived/local collector functions imported or executed. Hashlib supplies SHAKE streams; independent coordinate-array FIPS 202 permutation checks raw five-permutation outputs. Sampling parsers independently use modulo eta reduction and full-prefix bit extraction.
limits: This checks the exact standalone harness semantics including synthetic force_blocks/budget exhaustion. It does not establish a production sampler or full API speedup.
No independent standard KAT corpus was downloaded; raw permutation uses a first-lane known answer and 24 independently computed SHAKE sponge comparisons to hashlib.

gpu_lifecycle_scope: All 27 nonoverlapping benchmark process intervals have a ten-second consecutive idle prelaunch tail; all post snapshots have no compute processes and end with three idle snapshots. No continuous exclusive-use claim.
scope: Standalone Keccak/SHAKE and sampling parser harness; only the Keccak state backend differs. Both variants use the same lane-zero sampling parser. Includes synthetic forced refill/exhaustion fixtures and SHAKE boundary cases. Original nine production modules are not loaded. No production split32, ballot-compaction comparison, or end-to-end ML-DSA speedup is established.
outline_completion_interpretation: This intake accepts this exact standalone operator matrix only. The absence of separate shuffle or ballot backends is a scope description, not an assertion that the outline explicitly requires those experiments.
limitations: Standalone operators using sealed donor Keccak and scalar-comparator sources; original nine DSOs are neither modified nor loaded.
Sampling uses the same lane-zero parser in both backends; this isolates Keccak state mapping, not ballot-compaction performance.
Kernel event times include output initialization, decoding and trace writes; no end-to-end production-module speedup is established.
ON/OFF changes this audit harness only. OFF uses eight squeeze blocks, rather than a production-module early-stop configuration.
Forced-rejection cases are synthetic refill/exhaustion fixtures, not normal FIPS vectors.
256 deterministic input rows are tiled across each batch; empty-input SHAKE has one unique row. Three processes reuse the same corpus.
All requests/bytes and counters are checked before and after each timed variant; individual intermediate timed outputs are not separately checked.
Shared stage lock and pre/post idle GPU samples are used; continuous exclusive GPU use is not claimed.
CPU-only self-tests do not establish CUDA compilation or device correctness; those must pass on the server before acceptance.
local_audit_limitations: No archived scripts executed; no SSH/GPU runs.

Independent sampling arithmetic and raw five-permutation CPU reconstruction passed in the bound companion report. This checks exact harness semantics, including synthetic rejection/exhaustion, and does not establish production API behavior.
The evidence tiles 256 deterministic input rows across a batch, and three process blocks share the same inputs.

The complete original source tree and selected source copies were locally rehashed; original nvcc identity is recorded remote metadata and the original nine DSOs are not loaded or reverified by this standalone experiment.
